description: There are many smartphones under Rs. 35,000 in India that offer decent performance for their price. title: Best Smartphones with Highest AnTuTu Scores Under Rs. 35,000: Vivo T5 5G, OnePlus Nord CE 6 and More

description: Pensioners in India are required to submit a life certificate every year to continue receiving their pension. Traditionally, this process involves visiting a bank or post office in person. This can especially be difficult for elderly pensioners and those with limited mobility. The government's Jeevan Pramaan scheme offers a digital alternative, which allows pensioners to generate and submit a Digital Life Certificate (DLC) using Aadhaar-based biometric authentication. The certificate is stored online and can be accessed by both the pensioner and their Pension Disbursing Agency (PDA). Pensioners can generate it themselves using the Jeevan Pramaan app or seek assistance at an authorised service centre.
title: How to Use the Jeevan Pramaan App to Submit a Life Certificate Online

title: Jio vs Airtel vs Vi: 84 Days Prepaid Plans Compared

description: ChatGPT Go subscribers in India who claimed the 12-month free offer can cancel their plans if they don't want to continue with a paid subscription. The plan costs Rs. 399 per month after the promotional period. Users can cancel through the ChatGPT website, Google Play Store or Apple App Store, depending on where they originally signed up. However, cancelling a promotional subscription could end access to Go benefits immediately. OpenAI also recommends cancelling at least 24 hours before the next billing date.
title: How to Cancel Your Free ChatGPT Go Subscription: A Step-by-Step Guide
